scenes.text: Have you ever wondered why purple is completely missing from almost every single ancient national flag, despite it being universally known as the ultimate color of royalty?

It turns out that back then, creating just one single gram of this legendary dye actually required harvesting, crushing, and boiling tens of thousands of tiny, rotting sea snails in massive open-air vats.

This brutal chemical process produced an incredibly foul, unbearable stench of decaying fish mixed with garlic that blanketed entire coastal cities, meaning the color of kings literally smelled like hot trash.
Since only the absolute wealthiest emperors could ever afford to buy and wear this disgusting status symbol, tell me if you would wear rotting snail slime to look rich, and follow for more.

meta.title: The Disgusting Reason Purple Was Outlawed For Normal People #shorts
